narrative:
Clermont County has 149,704 registered voters, with 15.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.4%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 15.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.4% of registrants.
